description: This file defines a custom Android View called DialView used to demonstrate accessibility features. It renders a multi-position dial that can be interacted with, and it manually handles accessibility events to support assistive technologies like TalkBack.

classes.name: DialView
classes.description: A custom View that displays a multi-position dial and handles accessibility events to provide spoken feedback and interaction hints.

methods.name: DialView
methods.description: Constructor called when inflating the view from XML. Sets up paints and click listener to handle user interactions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes paint objects and click listener, sets initial selection, and manages accessibility event sending.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Calculates drawing bounds, radius, and layout metrics whenever the view size changes.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles rendering of the dial circle, labels, and indicator based on current selection.

methods.name: onPopulateAccessibilityEvent
methods.description: Populates accessibility events with the current mode information and instructions for assistive technologies.

methods.name: computeXYForPosition
methods.description: Calculates the X and Y coordinates for labels and indicator placement based on position index.
